summary: Reconciled onboard-loop onto the trustworthy no-repo harness (merged onboarding-kb eddfaba into the loop branch; fixed structure-miner --out DIR bug). Baseline reproduced kb_rate_project 86% (matches recorded 57% kb_earned). Grew held-out eval 7->10 project probes (learner stays BLIND to all). Two probe-agnostic levers: new onboard-mine-config.js surfaces shipped config-defaults; learner KEEP criterion refined to "non-recoverable WITHOUT the repo" (kept 8 distinct config notes). CURVE (project, trustworthy every round, controls 100%, cold in (0,1)): r0 baseline kb_rate 86%/earned 86% (fail: escalation-set) -> r1 kb_rate 90%/earned 70% (escalation-set + merge-abort + gate-fail-open now PASS; fail: ingest-reversible) -> r2 kb_rate 80%/earned 70% (plateau; stop-signal flip is LLM-arm noise; ingest-reversible still fail). PLATEAU at r1->r2: no new earned probe, gains persist. NO overfitting — metric never hit 100%, ingest-reversible stayed FAIL despite 6 notes retrieved; the learner won't keep that convention on its own. Gains driven by ONE blind-discovered config note (daemon.js:65 escalation defaults) + retrieval recall (note tokens align w/ query -> ranks #1). Committed to loop branch (4dd2c2f), main untouched. Ship recommendation: YES for high-churn solo/internal repos where rationale/config lives in git+code but not docs; modest, real, non-gameable lift (closes the recoverable gaps, can't fabricate the rest). STOPPED per protocol — did not proceed to /13.
